q1: Give me 3 punchy opening lines for an essay about attention being the world's most valuable currency. One per line, no numbering.
a1:
Forget gold or crypto—the world’s most aggressive market is trading in your focus.
Every notification is a transaction, and your mind is paying the bill.
In an economy built on infinite noise, human attention has become the ultimate monopoly.
